scope: float-domain source-equation mirror; not a C++ differential test or product image evaluation
format: IEEE-like Python floats; 17^3 table and sampler arithmetic use numpy float32 where source stores float
contract_notes: ColorLUT lookup sanitizes non-finite RGB to 0 and clamps lookup input/output to [0,1].
LUTEffect intensity 0 leaves source RGB unchanged; intermediate values linearly mix source RGB with mapped RGB; intensity >= 0.9999 uses mapped RGB directly.
LUTEffect copies RGBA then writes only RGB channels, so alpha is preserved by the inspected CPU implementation.
HDR RGB is not preserved at full intensity. Intermediate intensity mixes HDR source values with the clamped LUT output.

alpha_association_probe.source_format: QImage::Format_ARGB32_Premultiplied is tagged sRGB/Premultiplied at the composition image-effect boundary
alpha_association_probe.conversion_back: ImageF32x4_RGBA::toQImage targets sRGB straight alpha and unpremultiplies source RGB
alpha_association_probe.purpose: Sweep identical straight RGB through straight and premultiplied source-equation paths; unpremultiply the latter for display comparison.

alpha_fixture_patch_probe.scope: source-equation mirror at the fixture's constant-color fixed-alpha patches; not a PNG decoder, C++ differential test, or product render

max_visible_alpha_error_by_look.metric: worst per-channel RGB difference after output unpremultiplication, before and after [0,1] output clipping; alpha-byte-0 pixels excluded
max_visible_alpha_error_by_look.scope: source-equation mirror summary only; not a quality gate or C++/runtime result
